meta.name: hyperframes-registry
meta.description: Search, install, and wire registry blocks and components into HyperFrames compositions. Use BEFORE hand-building any named visual — whenever a brief, a user, or a storyboard names a look, effect, treatment, or transition such as CRT scanlines, glitch, chromatic aberration, film grain, a shimmer sweep, a chart, a code or terminal window, a map, or a confetti burst — because roughly 400 hosted items already cover many of them and the search ranks all of them with nothing installed, no project, and no account. Also use when running hyperframes add or hyperframes catalog, installing one item or every block matching a tag, wiring an installed item into index.html, or working with hyperframes.json. Covers discovery, install locations, block sub-composition wiring, component snippet merging, and authoring a new block or component to contribute upstream (idea → scaffold → validate → PR).

copy.tagline: 挑选扫描线、故障、胶片颗粒等现成特效,装进你的画面合成里
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在做视频或动画合成,又不想每个特效都从零手写。
copy.tagline_en: Pick ready-made visual effects and drop them into your composition
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building a video or animation and don't want to code every effect from scratch.

howto.what: Claude 会先用 hyperframes 命令在约 400 项的注册表里搜索、安装可复用的 block 或 component,并给出接进 index.html 的粘贴片段。它也能浏览目录、报告目录里没有的效果,或按模板撰写新条目投稿。
howto.when: 当分镜、简报或你点名某种视觉效果(CRT 扫描线、glitch 等),或要运行 hyperframes add / catalog、把已装项接进 index.html 时接管。
